items.t: Takata passenger airbag inflator (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Replace passenger airbag inflator or module
items.note: Do-not-drive recall; repair is free. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: ABS valves stick, brake pedal travels farther
items.job: Flush brakes; replace ABS hydraulic unit if needed
items.note: Covered by a Ford recall; many cars need only a brake fluid flush. Check your VIN.

items.t: Driver floor mat can snag the gas pedal
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: AWD power transfer unit leak or burnt fluid
items.job: Replace PTU seals and change PTU fluid
items.note: If the unit has failed, a replacement PTU costs much more.

items.t: Throttle body fault causes limp mode
items.job: Replace throttle body and do relearn
items.note: Ford once extended throttle body coverage on some cars; ask a dealer to check your VIN.

items.t: Sudden loss of power steering assist
items.note: A recall covers many 2011-2012 cars, sometimes with only a software update. Check your VIN.

items.t: Fuel tank can crack from EVAP purge valve fault
items.job: Replace canister purge valve and update software
items.note: Covered by a Ford recall; check your VIN. If the tank is cracked, replacing it adds a lot.

items.t: Wheel studs can break on 17-inch steel wheels
items.job: Replace broken wheel studs and lug nuts
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Engine overheating and fire risk
items.job: Add coolant level sensor and update software
items.note: Covered by a Ford recall; check your VIN. Cost rises a lot if the engine was damaged.

items.t: Manual transmission clutch can break
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Shifter cable bushing can detach (rollaway risk)
items.job: Replace shifter cable bushing and add cap
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Door won't stay latched
items.note: Price is per door. Covered by Ford door latch recalls; check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Steering motor bolts corrode, assist cuts out
items.job: Replace steering motor bolts and seal them
items.note: Covered by a Ford recall; check your VIN. If bolts are broken, a new steering gear is needed.

items.t: Fuel delivery module can crack and leak
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Steering gear missing retaining clip
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Airbag control module can short out
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Front seat belt anchor cable can fail in a crash
items.job: Coat or replace front seat belt anchor cable
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Front brake hose can rupture
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Brake pedal stop pad falls off
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Steering wheel bolt can loosen
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Coolant leaking into the cylinders
items.note: Ford extended coverage on many 2017-2019 cars, but it may have ended. Check your VIN with a dealer.

items.t: Coolant loss and white smoke
items.note: Head gasket repairs rarely last on this engine. Ask a dealer about any goodwill help.

items.t: Torque converter can separate, loss of drive
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Engine block heater can crack and short
items.job: Replace block heater or install blanking plug
items.note: Do not plug in the heater until fixed. Covered by a Ford recall; check your VIN.

items.t: Plug-in hybrid battery control module damage
items.job: Replace battery energy control module and update
items.note: Do not charge until fixed; Ford's recall may replace the battery. If the battery pack is damaged, cost is much higher.

items.t: Backup camera blank or distorted
items.note: Some years are fixed with a free software update under recall. Check your VIN.
